name: Hatsuhime
source:
The princess of the Mochizuki clan. A bit tomboyish and prone to sneaking out of the castle at night, she frustrates her guardians. She gets caught up in a clan-succession conspiracy, one that seemingly proves fatal to her, and seems to reach out to Sayori through the mysterious green pendant that Sayori finds at the very beginning of the story.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yo-Jin-Bo#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
